summary: Independent review of the PXD038505 QC SDRF (56 rows, 36 RAW: 16 single-label incorporation runs and 20 digest/mixing-check runs) found no blocker or important issue. Label override for A1-A16, per-run cleavage agents (RW3 trypsin only, RW5 trypsin + Lys-C), sample-to-channel mapping, instrument/CID/NCE and file coverage were re-derived from primary sources.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent without producer transcript; earlier review-* dirs not read; design sheets, QC MaxQuant summary/parameters/proteinGroups (HTTP range read of DNU7717QCtxt.zip), PRIDE files/all and 11 RAW headers re-fetched into review-qc-3

spec_compliance.evidence: Resolved ms-proteomics 1.1.0 + vertebrates 1.1.0 + clinical-metadata 1.0.0 (released latest in templates.yaml) with spec/scripts/resolve_templates.py: every required column present; only absent recommended column is comment[precursor mass tolerance]; reserved words only in columns whose allow_not_available/allow_not_applicable is true; no extra unlicensed column except factor value[genotype]; modification strings NT/AC/TA|PP/MT; row-uniqueness coordinate and source+assay+label key have no duplicates.

ontology_integrity.evidence: OLS4 resolved, none obsolete, labels exact: NCBITaxon:10090, UBERON:0000956, CL:0010012, MONDO:0100039 CDKL5 disorder, PATO:0000461, EFO:0002567, MS:1001742, MS:1001251, MS:1001309 Lys-C, MS:1000133, MS:1000083, PRIDE:0000627, PRIDE:0000325/0000326, UNIMOD:4/35/1/481/188/259/267 labels match. sdrf-tools check: 18/18 verified, 0 UNIMOD swaps. C57BL/6 has no NCBITaxon term (EFO:0022397) - warning only.

source_evidence.evidence: PMC10713615 Methods: male E16.5 cortical neurons, C57Bl/6 backcross, K4R6 light / K8R10 heavy, LTQ Orbitrap Velos, o/n trypsin then Lys-C 2 h + o/n trypsin with mixing/digestion checks after each step, CID NCE 30% in ion trap. RAW headers (A1,A9,A13,A16 RW3 'Digest of LB-n'; A17,A21,A26 RW3 'Digest of <mix>'; A17,A19,A21,A26 RW5 'Digest of Digest of <mix>'; all Top10CID, NCE 30.0, LTQ Orbitrap Velos). QC summary.txt: A1-A8 Labels1 Arg6;Lys4, A9-A16 Arg10;Lys8; proteinGroups median log2 H/L 3.5-4.9 (>91% incorporation) for both groups, confirming the override of Experimental_Design.xlsx label columns. MS/MS tol ITMS 0.5 Da in all three QC parameters.txt; fixed Carbamidomethyl, variable Oxidation/Acetyl.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE files/all (projectAccessions = {PXD038505}) lists 66 .raw; QC SDRF 36 unique + phospho SDRF 30 unique = 66, overlap 0, missing 0, unmatched 0; 16 single-label files x1 row, 20 mix files x2 rows; no peak lists.

design_consistency.evidence: Programmatic comparison against Experimental_Design.xlsx: all 56 rows match source/channel (mix E1-E3 KO light/WT heavy, E4-E6 WT light/KO heavy, C1-C4 same control both channels; incorporation identities from design with label corrected per QC search). Genotype/disease/factor consistent with source; 3 KO + 3 WT embryos x 2 dishes + 4 controls x 2 dishes = 20 sources.

omission_safety.evidence: Control 1-4 biology left not available (unstated anywhere); trypsin for incorporation digests flagged as inferred (supported by Trypsin/P search); precursor tolerance omitted rather than assumed; no invented per-sample demographics; Arg>Pro conversion re-search reuses A1-A16 and needs no extra rows.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf (bare names): -t ms-proteomics exit 0 clean; -t vertebrates exit 0 (warning C57BL/6 not in ncbitaxon); -t clinical-metadata exit 0 clean; union of three -t exit 0 same warning. sdrf-tools check CLEAN; sdrf-tools score 94/100.

findings.evidence: QC parameters.txt (MaxQuant 1.3.0.5) does not list peptide tolerance and no QC mqpar.xml was deposited; omission is justified, could be added as not available.

findings.message: C57BL/6 is not an NCBITaxon term; validator warns.
findings.evidence: OLS exact search: EFO:0022397 C57BL/6; no NCBITaxon hit. Paper says 'C57 Bl/6 (Jackson)' (substrain not stated).

findings.message: Technical replicate index spans different preparations (incorporation lysate digest, first-digest mix, second-digest mix) and Control 3/4 numbering starts at the mix check, so the same index means different things across sources.
findings.evidence: RAW headers 'Digest of LB-n' / 'Digest of <mix>' / 'Digest of Digest of <mix>'; legal and unique, but not true injection replicates.

findings.message: CDKL5 deficiency disorder is a developmental epileptic encephalopathy, not a neurodegenerative disease; caller should confirm the dataset fits the user's 'neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson's' request.
findings.evidence: Paper abstract: 'CDKL5 deficiency disorder (CDD, DEE2), one of the most common genetic epilepsies'.
